title: EOPatch and AAPS Erros
body:
Hello Milos, I noticed yesterday that after changing the EOPatch pump I could no longer access the configuration of the DYNISF. AAPS kept crashing. Today I switched to the virtual pump. I wanted to test if I could work with that in the configuration. With this setting, everything could operate normally. I believe that an error has crept in with the EOPatch. Currently I have the DEV G 378002df33 installed. It would be great if the error can be detected and fixed.---------
